mapper.insert: insert into lab_reservation ( id, applicant_user_id, applicant_name, department, contact, lab_id, reservation_date, time_range, scene, attendee_count, reason, status, conflict_flag, reviewer_name, review_remark ) values ( #{id}, #{applicantUserId}, #{applicantName}, #{department}, #{contact}, coalesce( #{labId}, ( select id from lab where lab_name = #{labName} or concat(lab_code, ' ', lab_name) = #{labName} or lab_code = substring_index(#{labName}, ' ', 1) limit 1 ), 1 ), #{reservationDate}, #{timeRange}, #{scene}, #{attendeeCount}, #{reason}, coalesce(#{status}, '待审核'), coalesce(#{conflictFlag}, 0), coalesce(#{reviewerName}, '待审核'), #{reviewRemark} )
mapper.update: update lab_reservation set applicant_user_id = #{reservation.applicantUserId}, applicant_name = #{reservation.applicantName}, department = #{reservation.department}, contact = #{reservation.contact}, lab_id = coalesce( #{reservation.labId}, ( select id from lab where lab_name = #{reservation.labName} or concat(lab_code, ' ', lab_name) = #{reservation.labName} or lab_code = substring_index(#{reservation.labName}, ' ', 1) limit 1 ), lab_id ), reservation_date = #{reservation.reservationDate}, time_range = #{reservation.timeRange}, scene = #{reservation.scene}, attendee_count = #{reservation.attendeeCount}, reason = #{reservation.reason}, status = #{reservation.status}, conflict_flag = #{reservation.conflictFlag}, reviewer_name = #{reservation.reviewerName}, review_remark = #{reservation.reviewRemark}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select r.id, r.applicant_user_id as applicantUserId, r.applicant_name as applicantName, r.department, r.contact, r.lab_id as labId, r.reservation_date as reservationDate, r.time_range as timeRange, r.scene, r.attendee_count as attendeeCount, r.reason, r.status, r.conflict_flag as conflictFlag, r.reviewer_name as reviewerName, r.review_remark as reviewRemark, r.created_at as createdAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt, l.lab_name as labName, l.lab_code as labCode from lab_reservation r left join lab l on r.lab_id = l.id order by r.created_at desc

select r.id, r.applicant_user_id as applicantUserId, r.applicant_name as applicantName, r.department, r.contact, r.lab_id as labId, r.reservation_date as reservationDate, r.time_range as timeRange, r.scene, r.attendee_count as attendeeCount, r.reason, r.status, r.conflict_flag as conflictFlag, r.reviewer_name as reviewerName, r.review_remark as reviewRemark, r.created_at as createdAt, r.updated_at as updatedAt, l.lab_name as labName, l.lab_code as labCode from lab_reservation r left join lab l on r.lab_id = l.id where r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update lab_reservation set status = '已驳回', conflict_flag = 0, reviewer_name = coalesce(nullif(#{reservation.reviewerName}, ''), '机房管理员'), review_remark = coalesce(nullif(#{reservation.reviewRemark}, ''), '驳回'), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update lab_reservation set status = '已通过', conflict_flag = 0, reviewer_name = coalesce(nullif(#{reservation.reviewerName}, ''), '机房管理员'), review_remark = coalesce(nullif(#{reservation.reviewRemark}, ''), '通过'), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
